content: When you create a username on WikiDoc, you are automatically provided with a User Page. This page serves as a platform where you can introduce yourself and share details about your medical background and qualifications. It is recommended that you include a concise biography outlining your medical education, degrees, specialty, research interests, or any other professional information you wish to share with the community. However, you should avoid posting sensitive information such as your DEA number, medical license number, or any other private details. You can also learn how to upload and insert your picture on this page. Keep in mind that this User Page is publicly accessible, meaning that patients or colleagues may come across it if they search for your name on Google. Additionally, there is a dedicated WikiDoc Physician Space Page. You can view an example of this page by clicking on the provided link. To personalize your own Physician Space Page, simply click on your username at the top of the screen and make the desired edits. Each registered user is also assigned a Discussion Page, also referred to as a Talk Page. To access this page, click on the red discussion tab located at the top of your User Page. This feature allows you to leave messages for other users on their respective discussion pages. Similarly, you should periodically check your own Discussion Page by clicking on the my talk link next to your username at the top of the screen. This is where other members of the WikiDoc community may leave messages or communicate with you.
